value.rationale: The seven-vertex torus is the canonical vertex-minimal triangulation of \(T^2\), and contiguity classes of self-maps are a natural discrete homotopy invariant. The result exposes a concrete structural mismatch: direct simplicial contiguity distinguishes all \(42\) affine automorphisms, while ordinary homotopy identifies each seven-element translation coset, leaving only six non-null classes. The exact image-size gap and absorbing-zero monoid description make this more than a raw count and provide a reusable benchmark for discrete mapping-space models.
